site.name: Đi Ngược
site.description: Fourteen places in Vietnam, with the best months, how to get there and how long to stay — and the months to stay away.

home.headline: We will also tell you when not to come.
home.sub: Nine years, fourteen places, both of us to all of them. Best months, nearest airport, how long to stay — and the weeks the rain closes the pass.

about.title: Who we are — Đi Ngược
about.description: Two people, nine years, and every one of the fourteen places in this guide walked in person.
about.headline: Two of us, nine years, all fourteen.
about.sub: We started writing this down because every guide we read told us when to come and none of them told us when not to.

story.label: How it works
story.heading: We go, then we write it down.
story.body: Every entry here is a place we have both been to. The months come from being there in the wrong one at least once. Where a thing is a matter of taste — how long to stay, which end of an island to sleep on — we say so and sign our name to it.
story.body2: We do not sell trips and we take no commission on anything you book. If a place is not worth your fortnight we would rather say so than fill a page.

letter.title: The monthly letter — Đi Ngược
letter.description: One letter a month: where it is dry, where it is not, and what has changed on the ground.
letter.headline: Where to go next month.
letter.sub: One letter, on the first of the month. Which of the fourteen is in its good months, which is not, and anything that has changed since we were last there.
letter.done: You are on the list. The letter goes out on the first of the month.
letter.promise: One letter a month. Nothing else, and no sharing of your address.
